$comment: Tier B — Product cards. Medium-volatility. Source of truth for product metadata, freshness, and evidence links. Generated views are built from this + evidence packets.

products.name: BMAD
products.rationale: Spec-first agent harness for turning vague goals into disciplined execution. Enforces planning, checkpointing, and quality gates before implementation begins.

conceptMappings.why: Strongest spec-first harness for turning vague goals into disciplined execution.
Best spec-first implementation loop when requirements discipline matters most.

products.name: GSD
products.rationale: Context-lifecycle harness with explicit checkpoints, budget control, and resume semantics. Best for durable multi-step agent execution.

conceptMappings.why: Best context-lifecycle harness with checkpoints, budget control, and resume semantics.
Best explicit checkpoint/resume model for recovering work without losing context.

products.name: LangGraph
products.rationale: Graph-based agent orchestration framework. Defines agent workflows as cyclic graphs with state management and tool execution.

conceptMappings.why: Most explicit graph-based control loop for stateful agent execution.
Features built-in central state persistence for branching, time travel, and durable execution.

products.name: ClawMem
products.axisRoles: Knowledge: Primary · Orchestration: Secondary · Tool Integration: Secondary
products.rationale: Local shared-brain memory engine for AI coding agents. Uses a shared SQLite/WAL vault, hybrid retrieval, and native hooks/plugins to pre-fetch context, capture post-turn decisions, and pre-compress long sessions before context loss. Exposes MCP for compatibility, but lifecycle automation is the main differentiator.

conceptMappings.why: Purpose-built shared memory vault for multi-agent recall across coding sessions.
Native Claude Code hooks, OpenClaw plugins, and Kotana memory-provider integrations automate memory lifecycle events.
Coordinates pre-fetch, post-turn capture, and pre-compress as automatic stages around each task.
Retrieves relevant historical context before the model begins reasoning.
Extracts and stores decisions, file modifications, and summaries after the agent finishes a turn.
Compacts active session state before truncation so long-running work survives context boundaries.
Also exposes a standard MCP interface for clients that need tool-style access to the shared vault.

products.name: Claude Code
products.rationale: Agentic coding assistant with CLI, desktop, and IDE interfaces. Orchestrates multi-step coding tasks with tool use, file editing, and terminal execution within a governed session.

conceptMappings.why: Full agentic harness with planning, tool use, checkpointing, and human-in-the-loop approval.
Native tool calling with MCP integration, bash execution, file I/O, and web fetching.
First-class MCP client supporting stdio and SSE transports for extensible tool integration.
Permission system with allow/deny rules, hook-based validation, and sandboxed execution.

products.name: Claude Desktop
products.rationale: Desktop chat interface for Claude with MCP server support, file/image upload, and project-scoped conversations. Consumer-facing experience layer for Anthropic models.

conceptMappings.why: MCP client enabling local tool servers for file access, database queries, and custom integrations.
Project-scoped memory and conversation context management across sessions.

products.name: Claude API
products.rationale: Foundation model API providing inference for Claude model family. Supports tool use, vision, extended thinking, and streaming. The compute substrate that other Anthropic products build on.

conceptMappings.why: Native function calling with structured JSON schemas for tool definitions and invocations.

products.name: OpenAI API
products.rationale: Foundation model API for GPT and o-series models. Supports function calling, vision, embeddings, and assistants. The dominant commercial inference platform.

conceptMappings.why: Pioneered structured function calling with JSON schema definitions in the chat completions API.

products.name: OpenAI Assistants API
products.rationale: Managed agent runtime with built-in threads, file search (RAG), code interpreter, and tool execution. Opinionated orchestration layer that handles state, memory, and tool dispatch.

conceptMappings.why: Managed harness with threads, runs, and built-in tool dispatch — but limited customization.
Built-in file search with vector store for retrieval-augmented generation.
Thread-based conversation memory with automatic context management.

products.name: ChatGPT
products.rationale: Consumer and enterprise chat interface with GPTs (custom agents), plugins, code interpreter, and web browsing. The dominant L7 experience surface for AI interactions.

conceptMappings.why: GPTs enable custom personas with instructions, knowledge files, and tool configurations.
Actions (formerly plugins) enable external API integrations via OpenAPI specs.

products.name: Vertex AI
products.rationale: Google's unified ML platform spanning model hosting, fine-tuning, evaluation, and agent building. Provides Gemini model endpoints, Model Garden, and Agent Builder for full-stack AI development.

conceptMappings.why: Agent Builder provides managed agent orchestration with grounding, tool use, and extensions.
Built-in safety filters, grounding checks, and responsible AI configuration.

products.name: Gemini API
products.rationale: Google's foundation model API for Gemini models. Supports multimodal input, function calling, code execution, and grounded generation. Available via AI Studio and Vertex AI.

conceptMappings.why: Native function calling with automatic or manual tool invocation modes.

products.name: IBM watsonx.ai
products.rationale: Enterprise AI platform with Granite model family, prompt engineering studio, fine-tuning, and watsonx.governance for AI lifecycle management. Strong focus on regulated industries.

conceptMappings.why: watsonx.governance provides model risk management, bias detection, drift monitoring, and audit trails for regulated environments.
Content filtering, PII detection, and hallucination mitigation built into the platform.

products.name: Azure OpenAI Service
products.rationale: Enterprise-grade OpenAI model hosting on Azure with content filtering, private networking, managed identity, and compliance certifications. Adds enterprise governance to OpenAI models.

conceptMappings.why: Azure Content Safety provides configurable content filtering, jailbreak detection, and prompt shields.
Enterprise RBAC, audit logging, data residency controls, and compliance certifications (SOC2, HIPAA).

products.name: Amazon Bedrock
products.rationale: Managed multi-model platform with Agents, Knowledge Bases (RAG), Guardrails, and model evaluation. Provides serverless access to Claude, Llama, Titan, and other foundation models on AWS.

conceptMappings.why: Bedrock Agents provide managed orchestration with action groups, knowledge bases, and return control.
Knowledge Bases provide managed RAG with automatic chunking, embedding, and vector store integration.
Bedrock Guardrails enforce content policies, PII filtering, topic denial, and word filters.

products.name: CrewAI
products.rationale: Multi-agent orchestration framework using role-based agents with hierarchical or sequential process flows. Emphasizes agent personas and delegation patterns.

conceptMappings.why: Agents defined by role, goal, and backstory — strongest persona-driven orchestration model.
Sequential and hierarchical process flows with task delegation between specialized agents.

products.name: AutoGen
products.rationale: Multi-agent conversation framework with customizable agent types, group chat patterns, and code execution. Supports human-in-the-loop and nested agent conversations.

conceptMappings.why: Conversation-based control loop with multi-agent group chat and round-robin patterns.
Agents can register and execute functions, code blocks, and external tools.

products.name: Semantic Kernel
products.rationale: Enterprise AI orchestration SDK for .NET, Python, and Java. Provides planner, plugin system, memory connectors, and process framework for building AI agents in enterprise codebases.

conceptMappings.why: Kernel + planner + plugins form a lightweight harness for enterprise AI orchestration.
Pluggable memory connectors for vector stores, enabling semantic recall across conversations.

products.name: LangChain
products.rationale: Composable framework for building LLM applications. Provides chains, agents, tool integrations, document loaders, and output parsers. The most widely adopted LLM integration layer.

conceptMappings.why: Largest ecosystem of tool integrations, document loaders, and output parsers for LLM applications.
Comprehensive RAG pipeline with document loaders, text splitters, retrievers, and chain compositions.

products.name: LangSmith
products.rationale: LLM observability and evaluation platform. Provides tracing, prompt playground, dataset management, automated evaluation, and annotation queues for monitoring agent quality.

conceptMappings.why: Online evaluation rules can gate or flag agent outputs based on quality criteria.

products.name: Pinecone
products.rationale: Managed vector database optimized for similarity search at scale. Provides serverless and pod-based indexes, metadata filtering, and sparse-dense hybrid search for RAG pipelines.

conceptMappings.why: Purpose-built vector store for retrieval-augmented generation at scale.
Can serve as long-term semantic memory store for agent context retrieval.

products.name: ChromaDB
products.rationale: Open-source embedding database for AI applications. Runs embedded or as a server with collections, metadata filtering, and multi-modal embeddings. Popular for local RAG development.

conceptMappings.why: Lightweight vector store optimized for developer experience in RAG prototyping and production.
Collection-based storage suitable for agent memory with metadata-filtered retrieval.

products.name: LlamaIndex
products.rationale: Data framework for building RAG and knowledge-augmented LLM applications. Provides data connectors, indexing strategies, query engines, and agentic RAG patterns.

conceptMappings.why: Purpose-built framework for retrieval-augmented generation with advanced indexing and query strategies.
Query engine tools enable agent-driven retrieval across heterogeneous data sources.

products.name: Guardrails AI
products.rationale: Input/output validation framework for LLM applications. Provides validators for hallucination, toxicity, PII, bias, and custom rules via the Guardrails Hub.

conceptMappings.why: Purpose-built guardrail framework with validator hub for content safety, PII, toxicity, and hallucination detection.

products.name: NeMo Guardrails
products.rationale: Programmable guardrails toolkit using Colang DSL. Defines conversational rails for topical control, safety, fact-checking, and jailbreak prevention in LLM applications.

conceptMappings.why: DSL-driven guardrail system with programmable rails for input/output control and dialogue safety.

products.name: Prometheus
products.rationale: Time-series metrics collection and alerting system. Pull-based scraping, PromQL query language, and AlertManager. Industry standard for infrastructure and application monitoring.

products.name: Grafana
products.rationale: Observability dashboard and visualization platform. Connects to Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and other data sources. Provides alerting, annotations, and team dashboards for monitoring agent systems.

products.name: OpenTelemetry
products.rationale: Vendor-neutral observability framework for traces, metrics, and logs. Provides SDKs, collectors, and semantic conventions. The emerging standard for instrumenting AI/agent systems.

products.name: HashiCorp Vault
products.rationale: Secrets management and encryption platform. Dynamic secrets, PKI, transit encryption, and identity-based access. Critical L6 substrate for securing agent credentials and API keys.

conceptMappings.why: Secrets management and identity-based access control for agent credentials and API keys.

products.name: DSPy
products.rationale: Programming framework for optimizing LLM prompts and pipelines. Replaces hand-tuned prompts with compiled, optimized modules using teleprompters and metrics-driven prompt tuning.

conceptMappings.why: Module-based pipeline composition with automatic prompt optimization as the control loop.

products.name: Cursor
products.rationale: AI-native code editor forked from VS Code. Provides inline chat, multi-file editing, codebase-aware completions, and agent mode for autonomous coding tasks.

conceptMappings.why: Agent mode orchestrates multi-step coding tasks with tool use and file editing.
Terminal execution, file operations, and web search as tool invocations.

products.name: GitHub Copilot
products.rationale: AI pair programmer with inline suggestions, chat, and agent mode. Integrates into VS Code, JetBrains, and CLI. Coding agent can create PRs from issue descriptions.

conceptMappings.why: Agent mode uses MCP tools, terminal commands, and file operations for autonomous coding.

products.name: Hermes Agent
products.rationale: Self-improving autonomous agent with a built-in learning loop. Creates and refines skills from experience, maintains persistent memory across sessions, and supports multi-agent parallelism. Runs on any infrastructure from a VPS to a GPU cluster.

conceptMappings.why: The defining feature: a continuous self-improvement loop that creates skills from experience and refines them during use.
Persistent cross-session memory with self-nudging to retain knowledge and recall past conversations.
Coordinator can route tasks to specialized subagents and share experience across agent pools.
Full web control, MCP support, and programmatic tool calling via execute_code for collapsing multi-step pipelines.

products.name: Hermes (Model Series)
products.rationale: Open-source LLM series (Hermes 2, Hermes 3) fine-tuned on structured function-calling and agentic JSON datasets. The backbone model for Hermes Agent and a popular base for community agentic builds requiring strong tool-use without proprietary APIs.

conceptMappings.why: Trained on the hermes-function-calling-v1 dataset — one of the strongest open-source models for structured tool-use and agentic JSON mode.
Commonly used as the inference backbone in self-hosted RAG pipelines due to its structured-output reliability.

products.name: {a}OS Hybrid Skill Naming Convention
products.axisRoles: Governance: Primary · UX Discovery · Catalog Quality
products.rationale: First formal {a}OS governance standard for naming slash commands and skills across the agentic workspace. Defines a hybrid convention with three rules: product-prefix (li-crucible) when a domain has 3+ skills, action-product (catalog-aos7) when a domain has 1–2 skills, and bare action words (scout, fix, close) for general workspace tools. The convention exists to make autocomplete intentional — typing a prefix should land on a coherent group rather than an accidental collision. Applied uniformly across Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini, and Opencode harnesses, and enforced by the unified skill registry. Sits at L6 because it governs how the catalog is structured, with secondary impact at L7 (how users discover skills) and L5 (catalog quality control).

products.name: Fallow
products.rationale: Rust-native codebase intelligence engine for TypeScript and JavaScript that builds a project-wide graph instead of working file-by-file like a linter. The free static layer analyzes a wide spread of code-quality dimensions — unused/dead code, duplication, circular dependencies, complexity hotspots, and architecture-boundary drift — with sub-second performance and roughly 90 framework plugins. An optional paid Runtime tier adds production-traffic evidence for hot-path review and cold-path deletion, turning quality scores into deployment-grade signals. In the agentic stack, Fallow is the deterministic check that pairs with non-deterministic AI codegen: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other agents call it via CLI or MCP to verify that generated changes don't introduce slop, dead branches, or boundary violations. Primary fit is L5 Evaluation & Quality because the entire product is a multi-metric quality oracle; L3 captures the CLI/MCP tool surface that agents actually invoke, and L6 captures the architecture-boundary enforcement that nudges it into the governance lane. In plain English: it's a fast, graph-aware code reviewer that scores codebase health across many axes at once and gives AI coding agents a structured way to catch their own mistakes.

products.name: Routa
products.axisRoles: Orchestration: Primary · Governance: Primary · Tool Integration · Decisioning · Memory
products.rationale: Workspace-first agentic delivery orchestrator using a file-based control plane. Tasks flow through a strict lane state machine (backlog → todo → dev → review → done | blocked). Strong governance enforced via file-budget, deletion-safety, and acceptance-criteria gates. Heartbeat pulse counter is a protected 50-year invariant.

conceptMappings.why: File-based control plane with explicit lane policies, review gates, and artifact contracts is a disciplined spec-first harness.
Lane state machine (backlog → todo → dev → review → done) is a strict task execution loop with built-in gate enforcement.

products.name: LiteLLM Proxy
products.rationale: One OpenAI compatible gateway over 100+ providers with fallback chains, per key budgets, spend tracking, and OTel export. Canonical gateway for the stack; also carries the L5 cost line and L6 hard budget enforcement.

conceptMappings.why: Virtual keys enforce hard per-agent budgets at the gateway.

products.name: llama.cpp
products.rationale: CPU first local inference runtime serving an OpenAI style endpoint. The degraded mode backbone: keeps reasoning alive on the existing GPU-less server with ally origin GGUF weights at zero cost.

products.name: Ollama
products.rationale: Friendly wrapper over llama.cpp with a model registry and one line pulls. The dev laptop convenience lane for local models.

products.name: Qdrant
products.rationale: Ally origin vector database that runs as one small container on the existing box. Chosen over hosted stores for zero license cost and over Chinese origin alternatives by policy.

conceptMappings.why: The vector store under the retrieval lane.
Backing store for semantic agent memory.

products.name: Docling
products.rationale: Parses the whole office document spread (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel) with real table structure on CPU. Native LlamaIndex integration makes it the ingest front door of the retrieval lane.

conceptMappings.why: Turns PDF and office documents into structured RAG input.

products.name: FalkorDB
products.rationale: Light RAM footprint graph store and a first class backend for Graphiti temporal memory. The runtime graph pick beside graphify code analysis.

conceptMappings.why: Runtime graph under agent memory and GraphRAG.

products.name: FastMCP
products.rationale: Turns the Python orchestration already on the box into clean MCP tool servers, tracking the official spec closely. The standard way the stack grows new tools.

conceptMappings.why: The fastest path from Python functions to spec current MCP servers.
Wraps existing orchestration as typed tools.

products.name: Playwright MCP
products.rationale: Lets agents drive the same Playwright and Chromium stack the verification walks use, through MCP, with no new vendor. Work time and verify time share one browser truth.

conceptMappings.why: Official MCP server over the browser stack the ghost tours already trust.

products.name: gVisor
products.rationale: Application kernel sandbox that hardens the Docker runtime under semi trusted agent code for zero dollars and one afternoon of setup.

conceptMappings.why: Kernel level syscall isolation under agent-run code.

products.name: Composio
products.rationale: Broadest catalog of prebuilt integrations that surface as MCP tools. Hosted SaaS with a free tier, flagged as a deliberate step off the self hosted posture when integration breadth pays for it.

conceptMappings.why: Hundreds of prebuilt LLM tuned integration toolkits, exposed as MCP tools.

products.name: Hatchet
products.rationale: Durable workflow engine on a single Postgres container. Layers under the overnight brain loops so a crash resumes from the last step; the file floor and board stay in charge.

conceptMappings.why: Overnight loops resume after crashes instead of vanishing.

products.name: Dagu
products.rationale: One binary scheduler that matches the files as truth style: YAML jobs in git, cron plus retries plus a web UI, and a built in MCP server so agents can inspect and trigger jobs.

products.name: Pydantic AI
products.rationale: MIT typed agent framework from the Pydantic team. Forces schema valid JSON across all three providers through one interface, which the zero dollar LLM lane already demands.

conceptMappings.why: Typed, validated model outputs as the contract layer.
A tiny typed agent harness when a job needs one agent, not a fleet.

products.name: Langfuse
products.rationale: Self hosted LLM tracing that speaks OTLP, so the OTel GenAI spans Atlas and Kotana already emit land without rework. Also the canonical audit trail store for L6.

conceptMappings.why: Every turn lands as an OTel GenAI trace with sessions and users.

products.name: DeepEval
products.rationale: Pytest native eval framework that gives the aos7 crucible judge a spine: versioned test cases, repeatable metrics, and exit codes for gates.

conceptMappings.why: Versioned eval cases with a pass or fail exit code gates can trust.

products.name: Healthchecks.io
products.rationale: Dead man monitoring for cron and loops: a job that goes silent triggers an alert from outside the box, closing the recorded external monitor gap.

products.name: Infisical
products.rationale: Machine secret manager beside Vaultwarden human passwords: per agent tokens, rotation, and env var injection, self hosted free.

conceptMappings.why: Machine secrets with rotation and env injection for the agent fleet.
Keys stop living in files on the box.

products.name: Open Policy Agent
products.rationale: A single free binary answering allow or deny over HTTP with policy as code. The one gate every risky agent action passes through.

conceptMappings.why: One auditable yes or no gate in front of risky tool calls.
Policy as code the fleet can version and test.

products.name: LLM Guard
products.rationale: Injection defense for the biggest real surface: agents reading hostile web pages, emails, and floor messages. CPU detector models, inserted as a gateway scan step.

conceptMappings.why: Prompt injection and content scanning on the CPU only box.

products.name: assistant-ui
products.rationale: Headless React chat primitives that drop into the existing Next.js dashboards, so Cyber Nouveau and the Compass pane style survive while chat UX stops being hand rolled.

products.name: CopilotKit + AG-UI
products.rationale: AG-UI is the approval wire: every agent raises a hand into the founder decision dock the same way. CopilotKit is its reference React implementation.

conceptMappings.why: Standard wire for agents raising a hand into the decision dock.

products.name: Pipecat
products.rationale: Voice pipeline that runs the whole loop on owned hardware: local Whisper ears and local TTS mouth, zero dollars per minute and no cloud outage between an assistive user and the assistant.

products.name: Typst
products.rationale: Compiles plain text into branded PDF artifacts in milliseconds on the server. Agents write text well, so daily briefs and reports become one command deliverables.
